description: Filter, rank and limit a scenario's per-model benchmark results. No LLM call. overall blends quality, speed and cost using organization task weights and is null if a component is missing. Status tags are independent: success does not exclude stale or stale_score results. Missing sort metrics come last in either direction. See enricher://docs/model-benchmark for interpretation.

limit.description: Keep only the top N after sorting (None = all).
limit.title: Limit

model_keys.description: Keep only these model composite keys (empty/None = every model).
model_keys.title: Model Keys

providers.description: Keep only these provider names (empty/None = every provider).
providers.title: Providers

status.description: Keep results carrying ANY of these tags: success | failed | stale (config_hash changed since this run, re-run it) | stale_score (reference/scoring config changed since scored, rescore it) | unscored (ran fine, never scored). Empty/None = every status.
status.title: Status

name: get_benchmark_scenario_results
title: Get ranked benchmark scenario results
